name: 91331 · Pacoima, CA
findings: ZIP 91331 (Pacoima) has 117 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91331 (Pacoima) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 28 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 6 hobby and sports organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
